name: Injected fault
description: A fault put into a circuit on purpose (ADR-034's fault mode): a cut (a broken wire, a cracked joint, a pin lifted from its pad) that conducts until it is made active, or a short (a solder bridge, a crushed cable, a failed part) that conducts only while active. The loader wires one in for each of a project's faults; its active input turns it on and off at any time.

fault.doc: open: a cut, conducting until active; short: conducting while active

roff.doc: Its leakage while it does not

initially_active.doc: Injected from the start (the active input's first value)

functional.claims: Conducting or not as the fault and its active input say.

omissions: an intermittent fault's chatter: it changes when the input does

electrical.claims: ron while it conducts, roff while it does not.
omissions: a cut's arcing or a short's resistance changing as it heats

sources.title: ADR-034: imperfections, limits and damage; the fault mode injects cuts, shorts and failed parts on purpose
